name: Lucky☆Star - Net Idol Meister
original_name: らき☆すた ネットアイドル・マイスター
source: A training simulation game of Lucky Star where Konata has suddenly decided to become a net idol, and in order to stay popular, she needs a manager, who happens to be you, the protagonist. You can also manage other Lucky Star characters.
translation: 一款以《幸运☆星》为题材的培养模拟游戏。此时，泉此方突然决定成为网络偶像。为了保持人气，她需要一名经纪人，而那个人正是你——主人公。你还可以管理其他《幸运☆星》角色。
